verdict.rationale: Portkey is API-first. All features are reached through a REST API at api.portkey.ai/v1 by swapping the base URL and adding headers, and the open-source gateway runs locally with one command (`npx @portkey-ai/gateway`). Both make headless, scriptable use plausible. However, the evidence never shows CI pipelines, non-interactive config management, or automation tooling, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs, a CLI for managing configs/keys headlessly, container/Docker deployment evidence, a published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
